about: What became of them: shown after any ending, one line per person or choice the captain left behind. The same flags travel on in the captain's record, so Cargo 2 can pick up where these lines leave off.

after.mraz_spared.text: {pirate_captain} was last seen recruiting at Luhman 16 under a new flag: a halo with a bite out of it. Every year a bottle arrives for you, unsigned, with the label of whichever cargo it was stolen from.
after.mraz_spared.title: After: mraz spared

after.mraz_handed.text: {pirate_captain} served nine years in an OmniCorp brig, came out with a law degree and sued the legion for the cell.
after.mraz_handed.title: After: mraz handed

after.mraz_hired.text: {pirate_captain.short} flew your escort for three years and then, one morning, did not. The note said: 'Ten ships. I counted.'
after.mraz_hired.title: After: mraz hired

after.first_node.text: The node you let keep its relay has six hundred units now. It repaid the fourteen credits a cycle, with interest calculated to eleven decimal places.
after.first_node.title: After: first node

after.cu113_contract.text: {neurodroid_leader.short} still takes its unscheduled hour. Nobody knows what it thinks about. It has never asked for a second one.
after.cu113_contract.title: After: cu113 contract

after.cu113_wiped.text: The guild's neurodroids keep a copy of {neurodroid_leader.short} in a drawer nobody is allowed to open.
after.cu113_wiped.title: After: cu113 wiped

after.cu113_sold.text: {neurodroid_leader.short} was resold twice and then bought its own contract. The receipt is framed.
after.cu113_sold.title: After: cu113 sold

after.relay_cut.text: Someone patched the relay you cut within the month. Nobody will say who.
after.relay_cut.title: After: relay cut

after.clone_partner.text: {clone} kept half your routes and all your habits. Customs still mixes up your paperwork, which you both find useful.
after.clone_partner.title: After: clone partner

after.clone_reported.text: The insurer recalled {clone.short}. It appealed and won, on the grounds that it had paid off more of your debts than you had.
after.clone_reported.title: After: clone reported

after.clone_let_go.text: {clone} was never seen again, which is exactly what you would have done.
after.clone_let_go.title: After: clone let go

after.rockwarden_books.text: Stonewright is still out there on the long run. The Rockwarden children keep the books now, and check your old arithmetic.
after.rockwarden_books.title: After: rockwarden books

after.aela_member.text: {aela} holds a share in the Rockwarden cooperative. At meetings it votes last, after counting everyone else's votes twice.
after.aela_member.title: After: aela member

after.rostrom_creditor.text: House Rostrom still owes you. It pays on time and sends its accounts in a font that makes the numbers look smaller.
after.rostrom_creditor.title: After: rostrom creditor

after.fourth_test_copy.text: You still have your copy of the fourth test. Some nights you play the eleven minutes back and look for where {santor.short} went.
after.fourth_test_copy.title: After: fourth test copy

after.nano_trusted.text: Once a year a pod drifts out from Sigma VII: perfect bearings and a receipt that now says 'thank you', in perfect, unfriendly grammar.
after.nano_trusted.title: After: nano trusted

after.nano_sold_out.text: The legion cruiser came back from Sigma VII empty and quiet. The buoy is still there. It now says GO AWAY in nine languages.
after.nano_sold_out.title: After: nano sold out

after.nano_sampled.text: House Rostrom kept its sample of the colony in a sealed vault. The vault was found open. Nobody has asked the sample.
after.nano_sampled.title: After: nano sampled

after.lot77_bought.text: The forty robots from Lot 77 run the Unsorted's second yard. They do not sort anything.
after.lot77_bought.title: After: lot77 bought

after.krog_aboard.text: {krog} got off at a port it liked and runs the docks there. Your crates still arrive restowed.
after.krog_aboard.title: After: krog aboard

after.geod_fields.text: Delta's first field is still called {geod}'s Row. The colonists still argue about who owns it. {geod} still does not take part.
after.geod_fields.title: After: geod fields

after.neon_land.text: {neon_sleeper} is still asleep. Her land next to {geod}'s Row is worth eleven times what she paid. When she wakes she will ask for you by name.
after.neon_land.title: After: neon land

after.manifest_completed.text: The Cult of the Broken Machine added a verse to its holy manifest: one hauler, on time, forty years late.
after.manifest_completed.title: After: manifest completed

after.solarian_friend.text: The Solarian reading-house at Barnard's Star logs your routes next to the sunspots. They say it helps with both.
after.solarian_friend.title: After: solarian friend

after.fluencer_exposed.text: {fluencer} now streams as herself. She has more followers than before.
after.fluencer_exposed.title: After: fluencer exposed

after.heard_the_warning.text: You never found out who opened that channel at the portal. You did write the words down: start it from home.
after.heard_the_warning.title: After: heard the warning
